dataset.license: Project-authored synthetic demonstration data; authorized for this project
dataset.provenance_notes: Generated locally at the user's explicit request. No bank/customer data, external dataset, or Kaggle labels were used. Labels follow the authored generation recipe, not independent annotation.

feature_definitions.description: Fictional transaction text; only model input.
feature_definitions.category: Single label assigned by the documented synthetic generation scenario; prediction target only.

category_definitions.Food and Dining: Prepared meals, drinks and food service.
category_definitions.Groceries: Ingredients and household food supplies for preparation.
category_definitions.Transportation: Local commuting, local transit, fuel and parking.
category_definitions.Shopping: Clothing, electronics and non-food household goods.
category_definitions.Entertainment: One-time leisure activities and event admission.
category_definitions.Bills and Utilities: Electricity, water, gas, telecom and connectivity charges.
category_definitions.Health: Medical care, pharmacy products and diagnostic services.
category_definitions.Travel: Intercity journeys, accommodation and trip services.
category_definitions.Subscriptions: Recurring digital content, membership and software plans.
category_definitions.Education: Academic fees, study materials, printing and stationery.

cleaning.policy: NFKC + whitespace; casefold key; remove all label conflicts, keep first exact normalized description.

selection_criterion: Highest mean training CV macro-F1; ties use declared model order. Test set never selects a model.

grouped_evaluation.grouping: casefold, replace digit runs, collapse punctuation; not merchant identity
